title: State secrecy laws are often profoundly at odds ______ the public's right to information.
subtitle: with

questions.en: State secrecy laws are often profoundly at odds with the public's right to information.

questions.hint: be at odds with + ý kiến/nguyên tắc/người: mâu thuẫn hoặc không phù hợp với đối tượng đó.

questions.en: The proposed cuts are at odds with the government's commitment to equal access.
